task.description: Produce design artefacts for WF-02 batch 7 (stage 16): DDL-04 (Idempotent batched backfill - extends DDL-03 three-phase form, backfill loop with IS NULL predicate, plat_migration_state recording), OBP-04 (Outbox gate hysteresis and escalation - extends OBP-01/02/03 outbox family, low-water mark at 80% of cap, plat_outbox_gate state, EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED event, admin escalation thresholds), ORD-03 (Sequence order guard and gap sweeping - extends ORD-01/02/04 ordering family, applied_seq cursor advance, gap sweeper on 60s cadence, DEAD status + DLQ routing, ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING), VLD-04 (Validation gate at authoring and promotion - semantic validation on draft save + /validate + promotion submit, semantically_valid verdict with CEL compiler version, 5s bound, DEFINITION_VALIDATED/DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED events). Read the full requirement bodies in docs/requirements.yaml (DDL-04 at line 11267, OBP-04 at 11940, ORD-03 at 12024, VLD-04 at 13240) - all acceptance criteria are authoritative. Read the referenced module families (src/platform/ddl_validate.zig for DDL-03, outbox/OBP modules, src/ordering/ for ORD-01/02/04, validation/VLD modules) and produce design artefacts under src/design/ covering interfaces, types, and data flow for each requirement, with no implementation code. Each requirement's design must cover every acceptance criterion explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: A design artefact exists in src/design/ for each of DDL-04, OBP-04, ORD-03, VLD-04
Every acceptance criterion of each requirement is explicitly addressed in its design
Designs contain no implementation code (interfaces/types/data-flow only)
Designs reference the existing module families they extend and the exact files to be touched
Requirement status updated to DESIGNED via tools/reqctl.py set-status for all four IDs
